segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You snatch the shiny red holiday box off the desk and shove it directly into the lead soldier’s outstretched wooden hands!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the soldier announces with alarming cheerfulness.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The soldier’s wooden fingers snap tightly around the ribbon. His pupils spin like tiny clockwork roulette wheels as his programming locks up:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: COMMENCING FOUR-HUNDRED-POINT HOLIDAY PACKAGING EVALUATION. CRITERIA ONE: IS THE GOLDEN BOW POSITIONED AT A PRECISE FORTY-FIVE-DEGREE FESTIVE INCLINE?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The other two soldiers immediately drop their weapons, pull tiny wooden rulers and brass magnifying glasses from their coats, and crowd around the box, loudly debating the tension of the wrapping paper:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: THE HOSPITALITY CREASE ON THE NORTHEAST CORNER IS CLEARLY DEFICIENT BY THREE MILLIMETERS!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: NONSENSE, LIEUTENANT! THE RIBBON DENSITY PASSES ROYAL INSPECTION!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: They're arguing over gift-wrap! Move, move, move!
